item.title: Splash Damage and Bromley FC
item.description: We’re proud to announce that we’re partnering with Bromley Football Club. We’ve been a part of the Bromley community for over 20 years, and it seemed only right that we support our local club. The Bromley Community Trust does amazing work in our borough; from providing free meals to school children, running collections for our local food banks, providing a platform for older generations to meet and support one another, running recreational football for women, and so much more. item.title: Victory for Splash Damage at the OneBigGame football tournament!
item.description: If you’ve been following us for the past few years, you’ll know that there are two things we’re big fans of: football, and supporting amazing charities. So, when we heard that Rare and Microsoft were putting together a football tournament to raise money for SpecialEffect, we jumped at the chance to participate. item.title: Splash Damage is going to Develop: Brighton 2023!
item.description: We’re just one month away from Develop: Brighton 2023, where we’ll be heading down to the south coast along with most of the UK games industry for three days of learning, networking and celebrating. The Develop conference is a highlight of our calendar every year and we love getting to see old friends, make new ones, and learn from the myriad of talks. As you’d expect, we’re attending this year. item.description: In September we officially kicked off our 4-day working week for all Splashers with a bang! Our studio is buzzing as we come back together again after so long. item.title: Gender Pay Gap 2023
item.description: GENDER PAY GAP REPORT Founded in 2001, Splash Damage creates team-based shooters that foster life-long friendships, embodying our dedication to diversity and our efforts to close the gender pay gap. Now in our 6th year of reporting, we’ve achieved a 7% improvement in our median pay gap and a significant 10% increase in women in senior roles, despite the sector facing unprecedented challenges, from widespread layoffs to economic uncertainties. item.description: GENDER PAY GAP REPORT 2023 marked the beginning of one of the greatest periods of uncertainty in the games industry, which has so far resulted in unprecedented economic pressures, widespread layoffs, and considerable uncertainty affecting studios across the UK and beyond.
